name: zec-yield-orchestrator
description: Oilskin — a Base-chain DeFi app for ZEC holders: use cbBTC, WETH or (when a market exists) cbZEC as collateral on Aave v3, borrow USDC, and deploy it into Aerodrome liquidity, with every position owned by the user's own smart account.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zyo/shared && npm run build -w @zyo/agent && npm run build -w @zyo/yield && npm run build -w @zyo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @zyo/agent && npm run test -w @zyo/yield && npm run test:contracts
